description: BRANCH_WRITER_EVIDENCE_IS_PUSH_TIME_RECEIPTS. Emitted at push time by resident-runtime/sv_push_receipt.py from the push itself: old_sha is the pushed ref read before the push, new_sha the same ref read after it, pushed_commits the commits old_sha..new_sha (git rev-list; no reflog). It becomes a LEDGER_RECEIPT only when the org-ledger writer transition (StegVerse-Labs/.github#3255) appends it to refs/stegverse/organization-ledger under the shared lock; the producer never appends. Modelled on sv-check-receipt.v1 (blob 070f13f4). Consumers (TVC#519 BRANCH_WRITER_IS_BRANCH_OWNER) accept a contiguous chain of these receipts covering base to head.

change_id.description: optional: the SV_CHANGE this push belongs to (svc: + 64 hex)

hb_epoch.description: supplied; ASCII digits, value >= 32 (org-kernel/kernel.py::supplied_epoch_failure); never from a clock

new_sha.description: the pushed ref read after the push

old_sha.description: the pushed ref read before the push; for a new branch, the fork base the caller names (an ancestor of new_sha), never the zero sha

pushed_commits.description: git rev-list --reverse --topo-order old_sha..new_sha: every commit this push introduced, oldest first; the last is new_sha

pusher_session.description: the authoring session that performed the push, as the pushing session declares it at push time

repository.description: owner/name of the repository pushed to

result_sha256.description: sha256: + hex sha256 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8) of every other field

title: SV push receipt (emitted at push time, appended by the org-ledger writer)
